conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation and low drawdown. Expect reduced volatility and a focus on stability, though market downturns can still impact returns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It involves higher leverage and concentration, which amplifies both potential upside and drawdown. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and strict stop discipline is crucial to manage significant potential losses.

plan: For income, we'll sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
High-beta single names like CRWD, SNOW, PLTU, and MSFU are also sold to near zero.
The focus shifts to income-generating ETFs and broad index funds.
This prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
A significant cash buffer will be maintained.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, aiming to park cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable monthly distributions from income ETFs. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
